page.notes: The Greek forms are read from a small, worn scan; accents and breathings in the verb forms are uncertain and may differ from the printed text. The left-hand labels (Iungor, Iungebar, Iungere, Iungi, Qui tur, Quæ tur, Quod tur) are row labels of the table, kept in the line. "ME=" at lower right is read as a catchword, with some doubt.
